title: EagleWrapper
subtitle: Eagle’s local APIs, in Python
description: Script Eagle’s V1 and V2 APIs to import, search and tag files. Also read a library from disk when the desktop app is closed.
longDescription: A Python wrapper for both generations of Eagle’s local HTTP API. It supports file import, search, tags and folders, plus reading a library directly from disk. The updated client makes remote authentication and API errors explicit.
features: Clients for Eagle V1 and V2 APIs
File import, search, tags and folder operations
Direct library reads without the desktop app
Explicit API errors and authentication support
